title.zh: 可访问表单与状态恢复

brief.zh: 活动协调员需要可使用的报名表单。实现标签与键盘纠错、等待、失败与重试；等待时修改输入，要取消旧响应的影响，避免覆盖或清空新输入。
brief.en: An activity coordinator needs a usable registration form. Implement labelled fields, keyboard errors, waiting, failure, retry and cancellation when input changes.

zh: 浏览器检查和修改记录
en: state tests and a revision note

zh: 键盘路径、错误提示和输入保留
等待后真实mock成功/失败状态可复现
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
A late response must not overwrite an edited input or clear it after failure. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 等待时改输入，旧请求结果不能覆盖新输入
failure.en: A late response must not overwrite an edited input or clear it after failure.

zh: 自动检查外的辅助技术与体验限制
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 活动协调员需要可使用的报名表单。实现标签与键盘纠错、等待、失败与重试；等待时修改输入，要取消旧响应的影响，避免覆盖或清空新输入。
等待时改输入，旧请求结果不能覆盖新输入；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: An activity coordinator needs a usable registration form.
Reproduce this failure first: A late response must not overwrite an edited input or clear it after failure.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.
